description: agent-fabric-gateway's rules for runtime/github/arm.sh. boundary.paths: the gateway carries every session's credentials and traffic, so its boundary is the credential confinement and upstream transport (crates/backend/), the listener, admission and local authentication (crates/runtime/), the protocol parsers that read a harness's request (crates/protocol/), the wire and configuration contracts (architecture/contracts/, architecture/config/), the dependency and build surface (Cargo.toml at any depth, deny.toml, .cargo/config at any depth, rust-toolchain), CI (.github/), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, auth, tls, crypt, sign, trust, parse, wire). The two crates rust-services-dev named for the first slice (crates/backend/http/, crates/runtime/gateway-runtime/) are cases. boundary.exempt is dropped first: Markdown outside the contracts, the decision records' prose under architecture/adr/, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.
